observation.command: su - dev -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && echo "=== 1. CONTAINERS ===" && ddev status 2>/dev/null | grep -E "web|db|openldap|phpmyadmin|phpldapadmin" | grep -E "OK|stopped" && echo && echo "=== 2. LDAP USERS (admin bind) ===" && docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap ldapsearch -x -H ldap://localhost -D "cn=admin,dc=example,dc=org" -w admin -b "ou=people,dc=example,dc=org" "(uid=*)" uid 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^uid:" && echo && echo "=== 3. DB TABLES + ROWS ===" && ddev exec mysql -uroot -proot db -N -e "SELECT CONCAT(table_name,\":\",table_rows) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=\"db\" ORDER BY table_name;" 2>/dev/null && echo && echo "=== 4. DEPS ===" && ls -d vendor node_modules >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "vendor: $(ls vendor | wc -l) entries, node_modules: $(ls node_modules | wc -l) entries" && echo && echo "=== 5. WEB HTTP ===" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "login page: HTTP %{http_code}\n" -H "Host: tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site" http://127.0.0.1:32789/login && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "root redirect: HTTP %{http_code}\n" -H "Host: tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site" http://127.0.0.1:32789/' 2>&1
